verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents manual journal entries as a first-party feature. Entries can be added one by one or bulk-imported via a CSV template, and edits post automatic reversing (voiding) entries, so the core posting workflow clearly exists. However, no evidence describes debit/credit balance enforcement or memo/supporting-note fields on entries. Missing for 10: documented balanced debit/credit validation, documented memo/attachment fields on journal entries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can post manual journal entries with balanced debits, credits, and supporting memos

citations.quote: Need to post more than one manual journal entry at a time? Instead of adding them one by one, you can upload a batch of entries all at once using Puzzle's CSV import template.
Puzzle automatically creates a voiding (reversing) journal entry for the original and posts a new entry reflecting your changes.
